title: No Free Lunch in Language Model Bias Mitigation? Targeted Bias Reduction Can Exacerbate Unmitigated LLM Biases
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'religion' as one of the four primary social bias dimensions it investigates. It evaluates and benchmarks religious bias alongside race, gender, and profession using the StereoSet dataset to see how various mitigation techniques impact model performance in these specific areas.
